description.text:
A special set for the 30th anniversary of Pokémon, released on 16 September 2026 with 128 cards plus secret rares, mixing new cards with reprints of old ones. Mewtwo ex and Mew ex lead it, with Umbreon ex, Salamence ex and Greninja ex, and every booster pack holds one of 30 Pikachu rare cards, each a different Pikachu.

As in Celebrations, a Classic Collection reprints iconic cards from the game's history, 30 this time, from Base Set's Charizard and Pikachu to Shining Celebi, Dark Tyranitar, Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND, Pikachu & Zekrom-GX and Arceus VSTAR. It also brought in Futuristic rares, two cards by the artist YOSHIROTTEN.
